Cat 5 Rail is seeking an experienced HD Mechanic, Mechanical Fitter or Maintenance Technician to join our growing Port Hedland workshop team.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on maintenance, fault finding and keeping equipment operating safely and efficiently. Experience in rail is not essential - candidates from automotive, heavy diesel, mining, mobile plant, workshop, mechanical or industrial maintenance backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Join a supportive team maintaining specialised rail equipment and mobile assets while building long-term capability within a well-established rail business.

Key Responsibilities
Perform servicing, maintenance and repairs across rail and mobile equipment
Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic and basic electrical faults
Complete preventative and breakdown maintenance activities
Service and maintain workshop equipment, vehicles and specialised machinery
Carry out hydraulic hose replacements, component repairs and general mechanical work
Complete inspections, maintenance reporting and work documentation
Maintain workshop housekeeping and high safety standards
Work collaboratively to improve equipment reliability and minimise downtime
Skills & Experience
Australian recognized trade Certificate 
Experience maintaining vehicles, machinery, mobile plant, rail or mining equipment
Strong fault-finding and problem-solving capability
Exposure to hydraulic and mechanical systems
Experience in workshop maintenance environments preferred
Rail, mining or heavy industry exposure highly regarded
Current C Class Driver's Licence (HR desirable)
White Card preferred
First Aid / CPR advantageous
Computer literacy and ability to complete maintenance records
Ability to pass medical and ongoing drug & alcohol screening
Benefits & Perks
Flights covered from Perth for FIFO employees
Port Hedland workshop location with long-term opportunity
Flexible roster options available
Ongoing training and development opportunities
Exposure to specialised rail maintenance and equipment
Supportive team culture with career progression opportunities
About Us
Cat5 Rail is a 100% Australian-owned family business with over 17 years of experience delivering specialised rail services across the Pilbara. With one of Australia's largest specialist rail fleets and modern workshop facilities in Port Hedland and Perth, we support our people with quality equipment, training and opportunities for long-term growth.

Job Title: Mobile Physiotherapist  

  Location:  NorthEast Melbourne 
 Employment Type:  Full-time / Part-time / Casual 

  About the Role  
We are looking for a dedicated and compassionate Physiotherapist to join a growing allied health team delivering high-quality, home-based care. This is a mobile role where you will work directly with clients in their own environments, helping them regain independence, improve mobility, and achieve their health goals. 

 This opportunity offers a high level of flexibility, allowing you to design a schedule that suits your lifestyle while still making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. 

  Key Responsibilities  

 
	 Conduct in-home physiotherapy assessments and develop tailored treatment plans 
	 Deliver evidence-based rehabilitation programs focused on functional outcomes 
	 Support clients with a wide range of conditions including post-surgical recovery, neurological, and chronic conditions 
	 Monitor progress and adapt treatment plans as needed 
	 Maintain accurate clinical documentation and reports 
	 Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team and communicate with relevant stakeholders 
 

  Client Base  
You will work with a diverse caseload, including individuals requiring: 

 
	 Post-acute and post-surgical rehabilitation 
	 Neurological and cardio-respiratory care 
	 Pre- and post-natal support 
	 General mobility and independence improvement 
 

 Clients are typically treated in their homes, supporting recovery in a comfortable and familiar environment. 

  What We’re Looking For  

 
	 Bachelor’s degree in Physiotherapy (or higher) 
	 Full professional registration 
	 Minimum of 2 years’ clinical experience 
	 Strong interpersonal and communication skills 
	 Ability to work independently in a mobile setting 
	 Valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle 
	 Commitment to delivering patient-centered, high-quality care 
 

  What’s on Offer  

 
	 Flexible working arrangements—choose your own schedule 
	 Supportive and collaborative team culture 
	 Ongoing professional development, mentoring, and training 
	 Strong administrative support to reduce paperwork 
	 Opportunities for career growth within a rapidly expanding organisation 
	 Access to a diverse and engaging caseload 
 

 The organization is committed to empowering clinicians to focus on what they do best—providing exceptional care—while being fully supported by an experienced team and efficient systems   Apply Now
